description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Charges module in the Fineract financial application. It uses JUnit 5 framework to test creating, updating, deleting charges associated with loans and savings, as well as testing tax groups and charge calculation logic.

classes.name: ChargesTest
classes.description: This class contains JUnit integration tests for various charges operations, including creating, updating, deleting charges for loans and savings, testing calculation boundaries, and associating tax groups.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, setting up REST Assured configurations and request/response specifications.

methods.name: testChargesForLoans
methods.description: Performs comprehensive testing of loan-related charges: creation, updating with various configurations, deletion, and validation of charge details.

methods.name: testChargesForSavings
methods.description: Performs similar tests for savings-related charges: creation, updating, deletion, and validation.

methods.name: testChargeUsingPercentageCalculationWithMinAndMaxGapValues
methods.description: Tests creation of a percentage-based charge with minimum and maximum cap values, and verifies they are correctly stored.

methods.name: testChargeCreationWithTaxGroup
methods.description: Creates tax components and groups, then associates them with a charge, verifying the tax group linkage.
